changelog: Full English rewrite. Same protocol, same channel ladder, same hard-won pitfalls (Codex resume flag order, Cursor CreatePlan swallowing output) - only the language changed.
summary: Cross-vendor adversarial review. Ship a plan, proposal, or design to a model from a DIFFERENT vendor to attack it; the defender rules on every objection; a final round converges on a joint consensus list. Optionally add a fresh-session judge to catch the blind spots both sides share. Invoke only when the user explicitly asks for it ("debate this", "have another model tear it apart", "adversarial review"). One model role-playing several experts is NOT this skill.
